title: NAFDAC Regulatory Assistant output
description: Where to find the answer, the crawled pages, and the run statistics.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: The single answer record for this run. answerType is one of registration, table, alerts, document, text. answerDetail holds the records; recordCount tells you how many.

pages.title: Crawled pages
pages.description: Every page and PDF read during the run. Open Storage → Datasets → pages on this run's page.

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Pages crawled, alerts found, table rows extracted, URLs visited. Open Storage → Datasets → runs on this run's page.

allRecords.title: All records
allRecords.description: Everything the run stored in the default dataset, unfiltered.

debug.title: Run key-value store
debug.description: All keys written by this run. Includes OUTPUT (the answer). Debug HTML snapshots appear only when debugHtml is enabled.
